issue: अज विधि घाता नाम: घाता ('slayer') does not fit Brahmā; his name is धाता ('creator, sustainer'). The book, Drik Panchang and Shubh Panchang all print घाता.
our reading: अज विधि घाता नाम (as printed): your names are Aja, Vidhi, Dhātā.

issue: अपर नाम हिये गायत्री: हिये ('in the heart') has no clear construction in the line.
our reading: Her other name, dwelling in the heart, is Gāyatrī.
alternatives: हिये as a filler ('indeed'); or a slip for another word (e.g. है ये 'this is').

issue: याको जन्म भयो को कारन । तबहीं मोहि करयो यह धारन: Brahmā's reasoning in his delusion; the second half is elliptic.
our reading: Why did it come into being? For this reason alone: that it bears me.
alternatives: 'It was then that it took me up (bore me)'; धारन as 'conviction': 'then I formed this conviction' (the glossary's sense).

issue: ब्रह्मरूप सब त्रिभुवन मांहीं: whether सब means 'all (things) in the three worlds' or 'we all (three) in the three worlds'.
our reading: In the three worlds, all are forms of Brahman.
alternatives: We three are all forms of Brahman in the three worlds.

issue: सो सब विदित वेद के नामा: what सो सब refers to.
our reading: Brahmā's praise of the Supreme Brahman (cau45) is known by the name of the Veda; it is liberation itself, supremely lovely.
alternatives: सो as the Supreme Brahman: 'he is known by all the names of the Veda; he is liberation itself'.
